lines.en: Good evening, and welcome to Maple Garden! Do you have a reservation?
Good evening. Yes, I booked a table for two at seven o'clock. It's under the name Lin.
Let me check. Yes, Lin, party of two. Would you prefer a table by the window or a quieter booth in the back?
A quiet booth sounds great. We'd like to have a nice conversation.
Perfect. Please follow me. Here you are. This is your table.
Thank you. It's lovely in here.
I'm glad you like it. Here are your menus. Can I start you off with something to drink?
Yes, please. What do you recommend?
Our homemade lemonade is very popular, and we also have a nice selection of tea and wine.
I'll have the lemonade, and my friend would like a glass of iced tea.
Sure. I'll bring those right out, and then I'll come back to take your order.
Here are your drinks. Are you ready to order, or do you need a few more minutes?
I think we're ready. Could you tell me what's in the seafood pasta?
It has shrimp, clams, and squid in a light garlic and white wine sauce.
That sounds delicious, but I'm allergic to shrimp. Can you make it without shrimp?
Of course. I'll tell the kitchen right away. We can add extra clams instead.
That would be wonderful. Thank you for being so helpful.
And my friend will have the grilled salmon with mashed potatoes.
Good choice. How would you like the salmon cooked?
Medium, please.
Would you like a salad or soup to start?
We'll share a Caesar salad, please.
Great. Let me repeat your order: one seafood pasta without shrimp, one grilled salmon cooked medium, and a Caesar salad to share. Is that correct?
Yes, that's all correct.
Wonderful. Your food will be ready in about fifteen minutes.
Here's your Caesar salad. Please enjoy.
Thank you. Could we also get some extra bread and a little more water?
Absolutely. I'll bring them in a moment.
Here are your main dishes. The plate is hot, so please be careful.
Wow, this looks amazing! Could I have some black pepper, please?
Of course. Here you go. Enjoy your meal!
How is everything? Is the pasta okay?
It's delicious. The sauce is perfect, and the clams are so fresh.
I'm so glad to hear that. Let me know if you need anything else.
May I clear your plates? Would you like to see our dessert menu?
Yes, please. What's the most popular dessert?
Our chocolate lava cake. It comes with vanilla ice cream.
We'll share one, and two cups of coffee, please.
Coming right up.
Excuse me, could we have the check, please?
Certainly. Here is your bill. The total is eighty-six dollars.
Is the service charge included?
No, it isn't. The tip is up to you.
I see. Can I pay by credit card?
Yes, of course. I'll bring the card machine to your table.
Here you go. I'll add a fifteen percent tip.
Thank you so much. Here's your receipt.
Thank you for the wonderful service. Everything was great.
It was our pleasure. We hope to see you again soon. Have a lovely evening!
You too. Good night!
Excuse me, could you help me? I'm trying to get to the central train station.
Sure. It's not too far from here. Are you walking?
Yes, I'm on foot. About how long will it take?
About fifteen minutes. Go straight down this street until you reach the traffic light.
Okay, straight until the traffic light.
Then turn left and walk past the big department store.
Is the department store the tall building with the red sign?
Yes, exactly. The station is right behind it, across from the bus stop.
Sorry, could you say that again more slowly? I want to make sure I understand.
No problem. Straight to the light, left at the light, past the department store, and the station is on your right.
Got it. Is there a convenience store on the way? I need to buy some water.
Yes, there's one next to the bank, about halfway there.
Perfect. Is it safe to walk there at night?
Yes, the streets are well lit, and there are always people around.
Thank you. By the way, is there an ATM near the station?
There's one inside the station, next to the ticket office, and another one outside the main entrance.
Excuse me, I think I'm lost. I was looking for the train station, but I can't find the department store.
Oh, you went too far. You passed the traffic light. Where are you now?
I'm standing in front of a flower shop on a corner.
Okay. Turn around and walk back two blocks. When you see the pharmacy on your left, turn right.
Turn around, two blocks, then right at the pharmacy. Is that correct?
Yes. Or you can take the number twelve bus. The stop is just across the street.
How often does the bus come?
Every ten minutes or so. It takes you right to the station in five minutes.
That sounds easier. Do I pay on the bus?
Yes, it costs two dollars, and you need exact change.
I only have a ten-dollar bill. Is there a place to break it nearby?
The convenience store is just around the corner. Just buy a bottle of water there.
Good idea. Thank you so much for your help.
You're welcome. Where are you from, by the way?
I'm from Taiwan. I'm visiting for a few days.
Welcome! Have you tried the local food yet?
Not yet. Do you have any recommendations?
Try the noodle restaurant near the station. It's cheap, and the locals love it.
I will. Is it open late?
Yes, until eleven at night. The beef noodles are the best.
Thanks again. Have a great day!
You too. Safe travels!
Hi there! Welcome to Urban Style. Let me know if you need any help.
Thanks. I'm looking for a light jacket for spring.
We have several styles. Do you prefer something casual or more formal?
Something casual that I can wear every day.
How about this denim jacket? It's one of our best sellers.
It's nice. Do you have it in any other colors?
Yes, it also comes in black, light blue, and olive green.
I like the olive green. Do you have it in a medium?
Let me check in the back. Yes, here's a medium.
Thanks. Is this jacket machine washable?
Yes, you can wash it in cold water, but please don't use a dryer.
Good to know. Is it water resistant?
It's lightly water resistant, so it's fine in a little rain, but not in a heavy storm.
Great. Can I try it on?
Of course. The fitting room is at the back, on the right.
How does it fit?
The shoulders are a little tight, and the sleeves are a bit short.
Would you like to try a large?
Yes, please.
Here you go.
This one fits much better. It's comfortable, and the color looks good on me.
It really suits you. That color goes well with your skin tone.
How much is it?
It's eighty-nine dollars, but it's on sale for twenty percent off this week.
Oh, great. So what's the final price?
That comes to seventy-one dollars and twenty cents.
That's reasonable. Do you have any matching pants?
Yes, these cotton pants go well with it. They're forty dollars.
Hmm, I'll think about it. I'll just take the jacket for now.
No problem. Would you like to become a member? You'll get ten percent off your next purchase.
Sure. What do I need to do?
Just give me your name and phone number.
Okay. Here you go.
You're all set. Will that be cash or card?
Card, please.
Please insert your card. Done. Do you need a bag?
No, thanks. I brought my own bag.
Here's your receipt. Please keep it in case you need to exchange the jacket. You have seven days.
Good to know. What if I want a different size later?
Just bring it back with the tags on, and we'll be happy to exchange it.
That's very convenient. Thank you for your help.
My pleasure. Have a great day, and come back soon!
I will. Bye!
Good afternoon, and welcome to the Grand Bay Hotel. How can I help you?
Hi, I'd like to check in, please. I have a reservation under Chen.
Thank you. Let me look that up. Could I see your passport and a credit card, please?
Sure. Here you go.
I see a reservation for a double room with a city view for three nights. Is that correct?
Yes, that's right. Is it possible to get a room on a higher floor?
Let me check. I can give you room twelve oh six on the twelfth floor.
That's perfect. Thank you.
Breakfast is included, and it's served from seven to ten in the restaurant on the second floor.
Great. Is there a gym or a swimming pool in the hotel?
Yes, both are on the sixth floor. The gym is open twenty-four hours, and the pool closes at ten p.m.
Here are your key cards. The elevators are to your right.
Thank you. What's the Wi-Fi password?
It's printed on the key card holder. You'll need your room number to log in.
Perfect. Could you send someone to help with my luggage?
Of course. A bellhop will bring your bags up in a few minutes.
Hello, this is room twelve oh six. My key card isn't working.
I'm sorry about that. Please come down to the front desk, and I'll reset it for you.
Okay, I'll be right down.
Here is your new card. Please try it again.
It works now. Thank you so much.
By the way, could I get a wake-up call tomorrow at six thirty?
Certainly. I've set it for six thirty.
Also, can you recommend a good restaurant nearby for dinner?
Yes. There's an excellent seafood restaurant just two blocks away. It's very popular, so I'd recommend making a reservation.
Could you make a reservation for me?
Of course. What time, and how many people?
Seven thirty, for two people.
All set. I booked a table for two at seven thirty under the name Chen.
Wonderful. How do I get there?
Turn left out of the hotel, walk two blocks, and you'll see it on your right. It's about a five-minute walk.
Thanks. One last thing: do you offer a laundry service?
Yes. Just put your clothes in the bag in your closet, and we'll return them the next day.
Great. You've been very helpful.
My pleasure. Please call us anytime if you need anything. Enjoy your stay!
Thank you. Have a good day!
Hello! Where are you headed today?
Hi. I'd like to go to the Grand Central Hotel on Park Avenue, please.
Sure thing. Do you have any luggage? Let me put it in the trunk.
Yes, I have two suitcases. Thank you.
Do you know about how much it will cost?
Usually around thirty dollars, depending on traffic.
Please buckle up. Is the temperature okay for you?
It's a little warm. Could you turn up the air conditioning?
Sure. Is that better?
Yes, much better. Thank you.
Is this your first time in the city?
Yes, I just arrived this morning. I'm here for a week.
Welcome! Are you here for business or for fun?
For fun. I'd love to see the famous places. What do you recommend?
You should visit the old town and the harbor. The night market is fantastic too.
That sounds great. How far is the old town from my hotel?
It's only about fifteen minutes by bus.
Perfect. Can you also recommend a good local restaurant?
Try the noodle shop near the harbor. It's cheap, and the locals love it.
What's the best way to get around the city?
The subway is cheap and fast, and you can buy a day pass at any station.
Is it safe to take taxis at night?
Yes, but always use a licensed taxi with a meter, like this one.
Good to know. Thanks for the advice.
I'll definitely go there. Is the traffic usually bad here?
Today there's a lot of traffic on the main road, so I'll take a shortcut through the side streets.
Sounds good. How long will it take?
About twenty-five minutes.
Actually, could we stop at a bank first? I need to get some cash.
Of course. There's an ATM on the next corner. I'll wait for you.
Thank you. I'll be quick.
Sorry for the wait.
No problem. Let's get back on the road.
Here we are, the Grand Central Hotel. The fare is thirty-two dollars.
Can I pay by credit card?
Yes, we take cards. Just tap it here.
Okay. I'd like to add a tip.
Thank you, I appreciate that. Let me help you with your luggage.
Thank you so much. Could I have a receipt?
Of course. Here you go.
If you need a ride back to the airport, here's my card. Just give me a call.
That's great. I'll call you the day before I leave.
Thanks for the ride and the great tips.
My pleasure. Enjoy your trip!
Hi there. Welcome to Green Cross Pharmacy. How can I help you?
Hi. I've had a sore throat and a runny nose for two days, and I have a mild headache.
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have a fever?
No, I took my temperature this morning, and it was normal.
Do you have a cough?
A little, but mostly my throat hurts when I swallow.
Do you have any allergies to medication?
Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin.
Thank you for telling me. Are you taking any other medicine right now?
Just a daily vitamin.
Okay. For a cold like this, I recommend a throat lozenge and a cold medicine.
What's the difference between these two cold medicines?
This one has an ingredient that can make you sleepy, so it's best to take it at night. This one is non-drowsy, so you can take it during the day.
I need to drive to work, so I'll take the non-drowsy one in the morning.
That's a good idea. Take one tablet every six hours, and don't take more than four tablets in one day.
Should I take it with food?
It's better to take it after a meal to avoid an upset stomach.
Got it. What about the headache?
The cold medicine already includes a pain reliever, so you shouldn't need anything extra.
Is there anything I can do at home to feel better?
Drink lots of warm water, get plenty of rest, and gargle with salt water a few times a day.
Okay. And how long until I feel better?
Most colds go away in about a week. If your symptoms get worse, or if you get a high fever, please see a doctor.
I will. Oh, I also need to pick up a prescription for my mother. Her name is Linda Chen.
Let me check. Yes, it's ready. Could I see your ID, please?
Here you go.
Thank you. These are her blood pressure pills. She should take one every morning.
Okay. Is there anything she should avoid?
She shouldn't drink grapefruit juice while taking this medicine.
I'll tell her.
Would you like to buy anything else today? We have a sale on vitamin C.
Yes, I'll take a bottle of vitamin C, and also a box of tissues.
Sure. Your total is thirty-one dollars and fifty cents.
Do you accept insurance for the prescription?
Yes. With your mother's insurance, the prescription is only ten dollars.
That's great. Here is the card.
Thank you. Your new total is twenty-nine dollars and fifty cents.
Here's my credit card.
Here's your receipt. I hope you feel better soon!
Thank you so much for your help. Take care!
Good morning! Where are you flying today?
Good morning. I'm flying to Los Angeles on flight BR twelve.
Great. May I see your passport, please?
Sure, here you go.
Thank you. Are you traveling alone today?
Yes, I'm traveling alone.
Did you pack your bags yourself?
Yes, I did.
Do you have any liquids, batteries, or sharp objects in your checked bag?
I have a small bottle of perfume, but it's sealed. And my power bank is in my carry-on bag.
That's perfect. Power banks must always go in your carry-on.
Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?
A window seat, please. Is there one available near the front?
Let me see. I have seat fourteen A. It's by the window, and it's close to the front of the economy cabin.
That's perfect. Thank you.
Please put your suitcase on the scale.
Okay. Is it under the weight limit?
It's twenty-three point five kilograms. The limit is twenty-three, so it's a little over.
Oh, I'm sorry. Can I take something out?
Sure. You can move some items to your carry-on bag.
Let me take out my jacket and two books.
That works. Now it's twenty-two point eight kilograms.
Here is your boarding pass. Your flight leaves from gate twelve, and boarding starts at nine thirty.
Thank you. What time does the gate close?
It closes at ten ten, so please arrive at least twenty minutes early.
Please place your bag, laptop, and jacket in the trays.
Do I need to take off my shoes?
No, you can keep them on. But please take out your phone and belt.
Okay. Is that everything?
Yes. Please walk through the scanner with your arms down.
I'm sorry, I need to check your bag. Do you have a water bottle inside?
Oh, yes. I forgot to empty it.
You can pour it out over there, or you can finish it before you go through.
I'll drink it now. Sorry about that.
No worries. You're all set. Have a nice flight!
Excuse me, which way is gate twelve?
Go straight down this hall, and take the escalator up. Gate twelve is on the left.
How long does it take to walk there?
About ten minutes.
Great. And is there a place to buy water nearby?
Yes, there's a convenience store right next to the gate.
Perfect. Thanks for your help.
You're welcome. Have a safe trip!
Good afternoon, Sunny Dental Clinic. This is Amy speaking. How can I help you?
Hi, Amy. I'd like to make an appointment for a check-up and a teeth cleaning.
Certainly. Have you been to our clinic before?
No, this will be my first time.
Welcome. Which day works best for you?
Do you have anything available next Tuesday?
Let me check the schedule. We have an opening at ten in the morning and another at three in the afternoon.
Unfortunately I work in the morning. Three o'clock would be perfect.
Great. Let me book that for you. May I have your full name, please?
Sure. My name is David Wang. That's D-A-V-I-D, W-A-N-G.
Thank you, Mr. Wang. And what's the best phone number to reach you?
It's nine one two, three four five, six seven eight.
Let me repeat that: nine one two, three four five, six seven eight. Is that right?
Yes, that's correct.
Do you have dental insurance?
Yes, I do. Do I need to bring my insurance card?
Yes, please bring your card and a photo ID.
Okay. Is there anything I need to do before the appointment?
Please arrive fifteen minutes early to fill out some forms. And please brush your teeth before you come.
Of course. How long will the appointment take?
About an hour.
Oh, wait. I just remembered I have a meeting next Tuesday afternoon. Could I change it to Wednesday?
No problem. On Wednesday, we have an opening at two thirty and another at four.
Two thirty works for me.
Perfect. I've changed it to next Wednesday at two thirty.
Thank you. And what if I need to cancel?
Please call us at least twenty-four hours before. Otherwise, there's a twenty-dollar cancellation fee.
I understand. Where exactly is your clinic?
We're at one hundred Main Street, on the second floor, right above the pharmacy.
Is there parking nearby?
Yes, there's a public parking lot behind the building.
Also, do you offer any payment plans for larger treatments?
Yes, we accept most insurance plans, and we also offer monthly payments.
That's good to know.
Great. Could you send me a reminder?
Of course. We'll send you a text message the day before.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. I'm looking forward to the visit.
Thank you so much, Amy.
You're welcome, Mr. Wang. To confirm: next Wednesday at two thirty. We'll see you then!
See you then. Goodbye!
Good morning. Do you have a minute? I'd like to check in about the project.
Of course. Good morning. Let me bring my laptop so I can show you the latest numbers.
Great. How is the new website coming along?
It's going well. We finished the design last week, and the developers started building the pages on Monday.
That's good to hear. Are we still on schedule to launch on the thirtieth?
Mostly. We're about two days behind on the payment page, but I think we can catch up.
What's causing the delay?
The payment system we chose needs extra security tests, and the testing team is busy with another project.
I see. How long will the tests take?
About three days if we start tomorrow, but the team can't start until Thursday.
Hmm. Have you talked to the testing team's manager?
Not yet. I wanted to ask you first, because I'm not sure whether we should wait or find outside help.
Let me talk to her this afternoon. I'll ask if two of her people can help us on Wednesday.
That would be very helpful. Thank you.
In the meantime, what else can your team do to save time?
We can work on the mobile version at the same time, instead of waiting until the payment page is ready.
Good idea. Do you have enough people for that?
Actually, I wanted to ask for some help. Could we bring in a part-time designer for two weeks?
What would the designer do?
Create the product images and the banners. Right now our designer is doing everything, and she's exhausted.
I understand. What's the budget for that?
About two thousand dollars. I have a quote from a freelancer who worked with us last year.
Send me the quote and a short explanation, and I'll talk to finance. I think we can approve it.
Thank you. I'll send it to you by noon.
Is there anything else you need from me?
Just one thing. Could you join the client meeting on Friday? They'll feel more comfortable if you're there.
Of course. What time is it?
Two o'clock, in meeting room B. I'll send you the invitation.
By the way, I wanted to say that your last presentation was excellent. The client was very impressed.
Thank you. That means a lot. The whole team worked hard on it.
I know. Please tell them I said thank you.
I will. Is there anything I should improve?
One suggestion: try to share problems earlier. Don't wait until a delay becomes serious.
That's fair. I'll give you a weekly update, and I'll tell you right away if something changes.
Perfect. That's all from me. Let's catch up again on Friday morning.
Sounds good. I'll prepare a short report for Friday.
Thanks. Have a productive day.
You too. Thank you for your support.
Good morning! Welcome to Sunrise Coffee. What can I get started for you?
Good morning. I'd like a latte, please.
Sure. What size would you like: small, medium, or large?
Medium, please.
Hot or iced?
Iced, please. And could I get oat milk instead of regular milk?
Of course. Oat milk is fifty cents extra.
That's fine.
Would you like any flavor in it, like vanilla or caramel?
Just a little vanilla, and less ice, please.
Got it. A medium iced oat latte with vanilla and less ice. Anything else?
Yes. What kind of pastries do you have today?
We have croissants, blueberry muffins, and banana bread. The croissants are fresh out of the oven.
Mmm, I'll have a plain croissant. Can you warm it up?
Absolutely. Would you like butter or jam with it?
Strawberry jam, please.
Great. Would you like to try our seasonal special? It's a pumpkin spice cookie.
That sounds tempting, but I'll skip it today.
No problem. Will that be for here or to go?
For here. Is it okay if I sit by the window and use my laptop for a while?
Of course. There are outlets by the window seats, and the Wi-Fi is free.
Wonderful. What's the Wi-Fi password?
It's printed on your receipt.
Your total is nine dollars and twenty cents.
Can I pay with my phone?
Yes, just tap it here.
Okay. Oh, I also have a stamp card. Can I get a stamp?
Sure. That's your ninth stamp, so your next drink is free!
Really? That's great news!
Here's your receipt and your table number. We'll bring everything to you.
Here's your iced latte and croissant. Careful, the plate is warm.
Thank you. Excuse me, I think this drink has regular milk in it. It doesn't taste like oat milk.
Oh, I'm so sorry! Let me check. You're right, I used the wrong milk. I'll make you a new one right away.
Thank you. I appreciate it.
Here's your new latte. It's on the house.
That's very kind of you. It tastes perfect now.
I'm glad. Please let me know if you need anything else. Enjoy!
Excuse me, could I get a glass of water, please?
Sure. I'll bring it to your table right away.
Thank you. The croissant was delicious, by the way.
I'm happy to hear that. We bake them fresh every morning at six.
I'll definitely come back tomorrow. Have a great day!
See you tomorrow! Enjoy your free drink!
Excuse me, could you help me find a few things?
Sure. What are you looking for?
I need olive oil and some pasta.
Olive oil is in aisle four, next to the vinegar. The pasta is in aisle six.
Great. Where are the fresh vegetables?
Right at the entrance, on your left. Today we have a special on tomatoes and broccoli.
Perfect. Do you have organic eggs?
Yes, they're in the refrigerated section at the back, next to the milk.
Thanks. One more thing: do you sell fresh bread?
Yes, the bakery is in the corner. The bread is baked fresh every morning.
Is there a sale on fruit today?
Yes, strawberries are two boxes for five dollars, and the apples are thirty percent off.
Wow, that's a good deal. Are the strawberries sweet?
They're very sweet. They came in fresh this morning.
Great. I'll get two boxes then.
Hi, I'd like half a pound of sliced turkey, please.
Sure. How thin would you like it?
Pretty thin, please.
Here you go. Anything else?
Yes, how much is the roast chicken?
It's eight ninety-nine each, and it's still warm.
I'll take one, please.
Great. I'll wrap it up for you.
Hi, did you find everything you were looking for?
Yes, thanks. Oh wait, I forgot to get milk. Can you hold on for a moment?
No problem. Take your time.
Sorry about that. Here it is.
That's okay. Do you have a membership card?
Yes, here it is.
Thank you. Your total comes to fifty-six dollars and eighty cents.
Here's a coupon for five dollars off. Is it still valid?
Let me check. Yes, it's valid until the end of this month.
Great.
Your new total is fifty-one dollars and eighty cents. Cash or card?
Card, please.
Please enter your PIN.
Done.
Would you like to donate one dollar to the local food bank today?
Sure, I'd be happy to.
Thank you. That's very generous of you.
Would you like a paper bag or a plastic bag?
I brought my own reusable bags. Can you put the cold items together?
Of course. I'll put the chicken and the milk in this bag.
Thank you. Could I get a receipt, please?
Here's your receipt. If you want to return anything, you have thirty days.
Good to know. Do you offer free delivery for large orders?
Yes, for orders over one hundred dollars, delivery is free within five miles.
That's helpful. I'll keep it in mind. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks for shopping with us!
Hi, I'm Emily. I don't think we've met before.
Hi, Emily. Nice to meet you. I'm Ming. I just joined the language club last week.
Oh, welcome! How do you like it so far?
I really like it. Everyone has been very friendly, and the activities are fun.
I'm glad to hear that. How do you pronounce your name? Is it Ming?
Yes, that's right. It means bright in Chinese.
That's a beautiful meaning. Where are you from, Ming?
I'm from Taiwan. I came here six months ago for work.
Oh, cool! What do you do for a living?
I work for a software company. I design mobile apps. How about you?
I'm a high school teacher. I teach history.
That sounds like a rewarding job. Do your students enjoy history?
Some of them do. I try to make it fun with stories and games.
I wish I'd had a teacher like you. How long have you lived here?
My whole life. I grew up just ten minutes from here.
Then you must know all the best places. Could you recommend some to me?
Of course. There's a great café on Oak Street, and a beautiful park by the river.
What do you like to do in your free time?
I love hiking and taking photos. On weekends, I usually go to the mountains.
Really? I love hiking too. Do you have a favorite trail?
There's a trail near the lake that I like a lot. The sunrise there is wonderful.
I know that one! I went there last summer. Do you also like cooking?
A little. I can make some Taiwanese dishes, like beef noodle soup and fried rice.
That sounds delicious! I've never tried Taiwanese food. I'd love to taste it.
I'd be happy to cook for you sometime.
Do you play any sports or instruments?
I played the piano when I was a child, but I don't practice much anymore.
It's never too late to start again. Well, it was really nice talking to you.
I enjoyed it too. Would you like to exchange phone numbers?
Sure. Or we could connect on social media, if that's easier for you.
Let's do both. What's your username?
It's emily underscore reads, all lowercase.
Got it. I'll send you a message so that you have mine.
Perfect. The club is meeting again next Thursday at seven. Will you be there?
Yes, I'll be there. Maybe we can go hiking together one weekend too.
I'd love that. See you next Thursday, Ming!
See you, Emily. Have a great evening!
Hey, are you doing anything this weekend?
Not yet. Why, do you have something in mind?
I was thinking we could do something fun together. We haven't hung out in a long time.
That's true. I'd love to. What do you want to do?
We could go to the beach. The weather forecast says it will be sunny and warm on Saturday.
That sounds nice, but I'm not a big fan of crowded beaches.
Good point. Then how about a picnic in the park? It's quieter, and we could bring food.
I like that idea better. We could also bring a ball or some cards to play.
Great. Should we invite anyone else?
Maybe Lisa and Jack. They always have fun ideas.
Good idea. I'll text them tonight. What kind of food should we bring?
I can make sandwiches, and you could bring some fruit and drinks.
Sounds like a plan. I'll also bring a blanket to sit on.
What time should we meet?
How about eleven? That way we can have lunch there and stay for the afternoon.
Eleven is a little early for me. Could we make it eleven thirty?
Sure, eleven thirty works. Where exactly should we meet?
Let's meet at the main entrance of Riverside Park, next to the big fountain.
Do you know how to get there? I can pick you up if you want.
That would be great. My place is on the way, near the subway station.
Okay, I'll be at your place at eleven. I'll text you when I arrive.
